claim: does design/divider/divider_intN.sch (the standalone programmable integer-N feedback divider, issue #27, retimed to a dual-modulus /2-/3 prescaler front-end by issue #114) divide a fixed 250 MHz ideal CLK by N=5 (NSEL[5:0]=000100) cleanly. N=5 is the smallest *odd* modulus in the DRAFT range (spec/target-spec.md row 4, N = 4-64) -- the odd decode path exercises exactly one /3 prescaler period per output period (ODD=1), which the N=4/N=64 even-path records do not. This is a design-input measurement, not a spec/target-spec.md ratification: row 4 stays DRAFT -- per CLAUDE.md, ratification is a separate decision-record act argued on its own merits. **Spec row(s)**: 4 (DRAFT target N = 4-64, static configuration -- this record supplies evidence toward that row, not a verdict on it).
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/divider/divider_intN.sch driven open-loop (no VCO, PFD/charge pump or loop filter in the path) -- CLK is an ideal rail-to-rail pulse source (12.5 ps edges, 4 ns period = 250 MHz, 50% duty, the design's own lock target) instead of the real VCO's output, and NSEL[5:0]=000100 (N=5) is strapped statically via lab_pin ties to VDD/GND. RESETB is released by a pwl at 5-6 ns (design/divider/DESIGN.md's own issue #114 diagnostic method). `measure.lock`'s target_hz (50000000 Hz = f_CLK/N = 250 MHz/5) plus a 2% tolerance and a 5-output-period window/hold reproduces design/divider/DESIGN.md's own issue #114 pass criterion, applied via the harness's general-purpose sliding-window lock detector. `require_lock` is true. process_corners is the ratified rows 19/20 PVT grid (spec/target-spec.md, DR-003, #77) -- this manifest declares the same full 5-corner x 3-temp x 3-supply default grid every other sim/ manifest in this repo declares, but issue #129 only asks for the two named corners here (tt/27 degC/1.80 V and ss/125 degC/1.62 V) at minimum, so this record's own Corner matrix run / subset-reason field states a declared subset rather than the full grid -- N=5's short output period makes it cheap per point, so the subset run typically also covers a few incidental extra points (the full local supply axis at each named corner/temperature) beyond the strict minimum.
analysis: transient, standalone divider (`tran 20p 260n`, injected by sim/harness/measure.py from this manifest's own measure block -- see sim/divider-n5/testbench/tb_divider_n5.sch's header comment for why the schematic itself carries no .tran card). The 260 ns window covers roughly 12.7 output periods at the target frequency (50 MHz, 20 ns/period) after RESETB releases at 6 ns -- more than the 11 edges (window_cycles + 1 + min_hold_cycles) the lock criterion needs.
